title: Eleusis DMTX retreat and research center in St Vincent and the Grenadines
place_text: St Vincent and the Grenadines, Caribbean

tellings.quote: running DMTX, but we actually are developing a a retreat center and a research center in the Caribbean. What's

plain: The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore says that besides running DMTX, a project built around the psychedelic drug DMT, his group is building a retreat centre and a research centre in the Caribbean, in St Vincent and the Grenadines. He tells Michels about it in 2025 as one of the people developing it, and mentions a group called New Nautics in connection with the work. If it goes ahead, it would be a dedicated place to study what people meet under DMT.
